# netbox_wireless_link (Resource)

Manages a NetBox wireless link (`/api/wireless/wireless-links/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_wireless_link" "example" {
  interface_a_id = netbox_interface.example.id
  interface_b_id = netbox_interface.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface_a_id` (Number) ID of the Interface (`netbox_interface`).
- `interface_b_id` (Number) ID of the Interface (`netbox_interface`).

### Optional

- `auth_cipher` (String) Auth Cipher. Valid values: `auto`, `tkip`, `aes`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `auth_psk` (String) Auth Psk. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `auth_type` (String) Auth Type. Valid values: `open`, `wep`, `wpa-personal`, `wpa-enterprise`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `distance` (Number) Distance.
- `distance_unit` (String) Distance Unit. Valid values: `km`, `m`, `mi`, `ft`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `ssid` (String) Ssid. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `connected`, `planned`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_wireless_link can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_wireless_link.example 123
```
